newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chinese firm says to buy more Miyakoshi shares.
newsitem.headline: Chinese firm says to buy more Miyakoshi shares.

text.p: A Chinese electronics parts firm which has recently become the largest shareholder in Miyakoshi Corp said on Tuesday that it will buy an extra six million shares in the Japanese company.
A spokesman for the Chinese company told a news conference in Osaka, western Japan, that the firm aimed ultimately to acquire up to 19 million shares in Miyakoshi, an electrical equipment maker.
Qingdao Sifang Dianzi Shangcheng Shiye Gongsi, based in Shandong Province, now owns 7.4 million, or 20.11 percent, of Miyakoshi's outstanding shares.
Miyakoshi said last week that until very recently it did not know that a Chinese firm had obtained its shares.
On Tuesday, a senior Miyakoshi executive told Reuters that the company is reacting calmly to the news and was not planning any measures against the foreign ownership of its shares.
